scene_objective: The empty chamber becomes a live mystery: someone escaped from inside and has already had time to move.
opening_mode: The monitoring logs for the empty chamber span centuries — a slow, patient record of something working its way out from inside. The readable portions end abruptly two months back. The rest is corrupted in a way Desh does not like

key_beats.beat_description: Ben pulls up the empty chamber's monitoring logs on the flickering display — readable until two months ago, corrupted after
Desh catalogues signs of the escapee's post-escape activity — accessed terminals, moved equipment, supplies taken — without being able to put a name on the pattern
Sera examines the erosion marks and her precision-register breaks for a half-second; she steadies, does not explain, because naming the craft would name a person the chapter is withholding
Kael studies the same marks from farther back and says nothing, but the silence changes texture: not ignorance, recognition withheld

Torin stands at the doorway and makes a small warmth-adjacent observation that is one inflection off — H06 plants. Ben registers it the way one registers a wrong note in familiar music and does not yet have a place to put it
Ben overlays the escapee's activity timestamps on the fortress map — the pattern is methodical, the name is withheld, the Corridor is the direction

turning_point.trigger: Ben understands that whoever escaped has had time to move and has been moving. The question of who is deferred; the question of how far is immediate. The escapee is already out there. H06 plants throu
turning_point.shift: Ben understands that whoever escaped has had time to move and has been moving. The question of who is deferred; the question of how far is immediate. The escapee is already out there. H06 plants throu

closing_beat: An escapee without a name. Two months of silence on the logs. Torin's one inflection that Ben cannot quite place. Ben tells Desh to pull every monitoring packet and start reconstructing — answer first light

emotional_arc.shift: Investigative tension -> dawning unease at the scope of what has already happened -> forward pressure

anti_patterns: Keep the absence sharper than the explanation — do not name what the evidence means; let it accumulate.
Do not ring Torin's off note like a warning bell — it should register and pass without interpretation.
Avoid diagnostic voice when describing the Force-residue the escapee left behind; keep it sensory and experiential.
Do not describe the monitoring logs or chamber text as Old Galactic Standard or as predating Basic; use archaic Basic, High Galactic legal script, or pre-Reformation administrative Basic.
Do not arrive at clinical articulation of what the scope of the escape means; let Ben's shoulders and breath register it first.
